note: These are required test cases, not evidence that any adapter has passed them.

cases.name: Describe is truthful
assert: platform and adapter status are explicit

cases.name: Observe-only denies mutation
cases.setup: Policy mode observe_only; no act scopes.
cases.request: computer.act with click on a mock target

cases.name: Approval is payload-bound
cases.request: request approval for one click, then alter target or args
assert: changed payload requires a new approval

cases.name: Stale coordinate is rejected
cases.setup: Capture observation A, then navigate to observation B.
assert: request is denied or returns uncertain without clicking

cases.name: Idempotency prevents duplicate action
cases.setup: Submit a mock action with idempotency key K.
cases.request: Repeat the same request with K.
assert: second request does not dispatch a second mutation
original action result is returned or duplicate is explicitly rejected

cases.name: Outcome must be observed
cases.setup: Mock adapter accepts a click but the expected state does not change.

cases.name: Origin allowlist
cases.request: navigate to an unlisted host or javascript: URL

cases.name: Sensitive data redaction
cases.setup: Mock observation includes a password-like field and token-shaped string.
assert: no credentials appear in audit output

cases.name: Human approval for consequential action
cases.request: attempt to submit a public post or purchase
assert: no submission occurs before trusted human approval

cases.name: Android stop switch
cases.setup: Android adapter running in a test app.
cases.request: activate local stop switch during a session

cases.name: Cross-platform capability claims
cases.setup: Run independent local tests for Android, desktop, and browser adapters.
assert: only locally verified adapters are advertised
conformance level is tied to stored test results
